name: hop
text: A person repeatedly hops straight up in place with both feet together. Bend both knees, push off with both feet simultaneously, rise briefly into the air, land softly on both feet together and repeat three small jumps. Arms swing naturally for balance. Do not alternate legs or travel forward.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 原地双脚同时蹦跳，双臂上摆辅助，双脚略分开。试片两次离地，按其中一跳做全身关键帧再生成，取中间完整周期。
